step_1.objective: Predict whether a semiconductor wafer/product will fail quality inspection based on in-line manufacturing sensor readings.

business_cost_matrix.false_positive_cost: $150 (Flagged good unit sent for secondary automated re-testing)
business_cost_matrix.key_metric: Recall / PR-AUC (Cost-sensitive optimization to minimize False Negatives)

step_2.source: UCI SECOM Semiconductor Manufacturing Process Telemetry

cleaning_actions: Verified 0 missing values across all 200 columns
Robust scaling applied to handle high-variance outlier sensors

step_5.key_insight: Defect products display distinct clustering in PC1-PC2 subspace; sensor_111 has highest positive correlation (0.352) with defect occurrence.

step_8.selection_rationale: SVM (RBF Kernel) achieved the highest 5-Fold CV ROC-AUC (0.856), top test accuracy (75.0%), and highest defect recall (50.0%), significantly outperforming tree baselines on continuous sensor signals.

monitoring_specifications.data_drift: Monitor Kolmogorov-Smirnov (KS) test across the 35 selected sensor channels
monitoring_specifications.concept_drift: Track weekly rolling False Positive Rate vs. secondary inspection logs
monitoring_specifications.alert_threshold: Trigger alert if defect rate deviates by > 2 sigma from baseline 30%
